text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Probe dot: mean over seeds, sky-and-temperature fit, dates July 2025 to June 2026. Other dots: medians; both earlier estimates use cloud terms. Lines: 10th to 90th percentile (5th to 95th for experiment 479). The probe line counts seeds and donor days only; the others count other uncertainty.'
text.tspan: Probe dot: mean over seeds, sky-and-temperature fit, dates July 2025 to June 2026. Other dots: medians; both earlier estimates use cloud terms.
Lines: 10th to 90th percentile (5th to 95th for experiment 479). The probe line counts seeds and donor days only; the others count other uncertainty.
